name: Being Turbanator Car Hanging
shortDescription: Signature handcrafted Punjabi culture rearview mirror hanging with gold accents and detailed beard styling.
fullDescription:
A celebrated symbol of pride, valor, and Punjabi automotive culture, the Being Turbanator Car Hanging is custom-crafted specifically for enthusiasts across Ontario and North America. Featuring a laser-cut metallic alloy silhouette with royal mustard-gold turban contours, sleek dark sunglasses, and a hand-knotted gold-threaded silk tassel, this piece brings unmatched presence to your rearview mirror.

Engineered to withstand direct Ontario sunlight without warping or fading, each unit comes with a durable braided suspension loop that fits all standard rearview mirror mounts. It arrives nestled in Brown Boys Customs' signature velvet-lined collector box — making it an exceptional personal styling statement or gift.
features: Authentic Punjabi cultural automotive iconography with sleek modern styling
Premium laser-etched high-density metallic alloy with anti-tarnish coating
Hand-finished gold thread fringe tassel with reinforced knotting
Heat and UV-resistant materials engineered for extreme Canadian weather
Packaged in official Brown Boys Customs luxury velvet gift box
Quick loop fitment compatible with 100% of car, SUV, and commercial truck rearview mirrors

specifications.Material: Reinforced Zinc Alloy & Premium Silk Tassel
specifications.Finish: Antique Gold Plating & Matte Onyx Enamel

installation: Simply drape the braided suspension cord over your interior rearview mirror and adjust to your preferred hang height. No tools required.
